narrative.northStar: A printed recharge ticket lying on a petrol counter: bone card stock, a cut corner, a dashed perforation, and a gold foil panel you tap to reveal the live code.
rules: Elevation is a hairline rule. No box-shadows except the focus ring.
The mark always sits on card stock, never on the counter.
Roles are semantic: gold = action and foil, oxide = destructive and revoked, positive = ready.
Tonal surfaces come only from the stock ramp or a declared role wash.
Tabular mono is the display voice; tracked caps label fields, never sentences or headings.
dos: Mirror every inset, origin, and the cut corner under dir=rtl.
Give codes, ids, and countdowns tabular figures.
Use skeletons for loading and teaching copy for empty states.
donts: No shadow-based elevation, gradient text, glass decoration, or feTurbulence grain.
No colored border-left/right above 1px on cards, callouts, or alerts.
No emoji or Unicode glyphs standing in for icons.
No cream ground with a serif display face.

motion.signature: The foil sweep: clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) on LTR, inset(0 100% 0 0) on RTL, then display:none after 460ms.
motion.busy: A vertical glint pulse on the veil icon (scale 0.92 → 1, opacity 0.4 → 1) — never a horizontal loop.
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all durations to 0.01ms and hides the veil immediately.

texture.foil-grain: radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, #fff1c4 0.85px, transparent 1.15px) at 3px 3px over radial-gradient(circle at 2.5px 2.5px, #b87a0f 0.7px, transparent 1.05px) at 5px 5px, under one broad 112deg sheen
texture.rationale: Metal must read as metal, but ink text has to stay ≥4.5:1 across the whole panel; grain coverage is therefore kept low so gold stays gold.

ticket.css: background: var(--stock-2); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 8px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 18px) 0, 100% 18px, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
ticket.note: 18px cut top-right; mirror to polygon(18px 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 18px) under dir=rtl.

tear.css: border-top: 1px dashed var(--rule-2); plus two 16px counter-coloured circles centred on each edge, transform: translateY(-50%).

foil.css: position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 108px; background: gold grain; veil absolutely fills the panel and is clipped away when open.

stamp.css: display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; padding: 5px 9px; font: 700 11px/1.55 mono; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;

notice-plate.css: border: 1px solid var(--oxide); background: var(--oxide-wash); color: var(--ink); icon injected via CSS mask so textContent can overwrite children safely.

sprite.rationale: The hidden attribute is ignored on SVG; a bare <svg> lays out at 300x150 and pushes 156px of dead space onto the page. Symbols stay referenceable by <use> while display:none.

i18n.rtl: html[lang=ar] gets dir=rtl; an inline head script applies lang+dir before first paint so Arabic never flashes LTR.
i18n.ltrSpans: Credential values, passwords, emails, and codes always render dir=ltr regardless of page direction.
